title: Purely Vanilla
description: This Mod Pack introduces a variety of optimizations and QOL features.
body:
# ![Purely Vanilla Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/93e2e550e3cb1b9f70c8a1d4de50fca9edf78bcc.png)

Purely Vanilla aims to bring a variety of fantastic optimizations for performance and game logic. It combines some of the most popular mods on the market today and will improve your gaming experience vastly.
